decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of quaking aspen: nearly round, finely toothed blades 3 to 7 cm on flattened petioles about as long, golden in autumn and drying tan to grey-brown. Colours and curl chosen by eye; numbers plausible, not measured.

look.note: Authored: the drawn look's mean hue at the brightness chosen by eye for this species' litter, the relief the drawing has, and a tile its pieces repeat on unseen. PlantGen's litter tests check the hue and relief against the drawing.
